name: Scroll
dimensions: Length 73 in; Width 16.75 in; Length 61 in; Width 13.75 in
summary: This is a scroll from a set of four which appears to have a connection with the Dowager Empress Cixi (1835–1908) of China. Like the other three scrolls, it has her seal at the centre top. The embroidery shows a red-crested crane and peony flowers, associated with a long life and royalty respectively

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
